# E0003: identifier without a letter

A name needs a letter, since the case of its first letter says whether it names a value or a type: write `first`, not `_1`.

- Rule: [`lexical.case`](../../reference/02-lexical.md#lexical.case)
- Reported at: the identifier.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `syntax` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0003:2
fn main() / io {
  let _1 = 5
  print("{_1}")
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
fn main() / io {
  let first = 5
  print("{first}")
}
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0003_identifier_without_a_letter.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0003_identifier_without_a_letter.lt):

```text
── IDENTIFIER WITHOUT A LETTER ── E0003_identifier_without_a_letter.lt:2:7  [E0003]

`_1` has no letter:

  2 │   let _1 = 5
    │       ^^

A name needs a letter, since the case of its first letter says whether it names
a value or a type: write `first`, not `_1`.
```
